text: Not sure if Im being daft. My neice is 6 and staying with me, her ezcema is flaring up bad on her arms, dry and itchy like usual. But tonight I noticed little dark red dots on her tummy and legs, like tiny pin pricks, and some bigger purpley bits. I pressed a glass on them like you see on the adverts and they dont go away, you can still see them clear through the glass. Her neck is fine, she can look down at her toes no problem. Could it just be from scratching??
